lines.trans: Dimochka, well do not get so upset.
I have nothing but nerves and stress right now.
I cannot sign a new contract.
Well, you still have your restaurant.
Right now it is no longer a restaurant, it is a furnace.
Then you need to change something there.
I have already changed everything there.
After all, you lured away my best head chef.
Barinov, you mean? I do not need him even for free.
Katya simply asked, and I gave him a job.
If you do not need him, maybe you will give him back?
Take him, of course, if he agrees himself.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'бирать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'take', paired with 'забрать'.

examples.text: Забирай, конечно, если он сам согласится.
examples.trans: Take him, of course, if he agrees himself.

examples.text: Я забираю детей из школы.
examples.trans: I pick the children up from school.

examples.text: Ты забираешь все деньги.
examples.trans: You take all the money.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Забирай, конечно, если он сам согласится.
examples.trans: Take him, of course, if he agrees himself.

examples.text: Да, конечно, диктуй мне точный адрес.
examples.trans: Yes, of course, dictate the exact address to me.

examples.text: Но это, конечно, не каждому дано.
examples.trans: But that, of course, is not given to everyone.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'yourself', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Забирай, конечно, если он сам согласится.
examples.trans: Take him, of course, if he agrees himself.

examples.text: Он пойдёт сразу в самый лучший ресторан.
examples.trans: He will go straight to the very best restaurant.

examples.text: Ладно, готовь сам, что хочешь.
examples.trans: Fine, cook whatever you want yourself.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'огласиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to agree', paired with 'соглашаться'.

examples.text: Согласитесь, это гораздо лучше.
examples.trans: Admit it / Don't you agree, that's much better.

examples.text: Она сразу согласилась.
examples.trans: She agreed at once.

examples.text: Это гораздо лучше, чем двенадцать лет. Согласитесь?
examples.trans: That's much better than twelve years. Don't you agree?
